messages:
Jess Carter: Heads up — prepping QBR for NorthStar. Need slide deck + risk radar + enablement asks. Meeting Fri 10AM PT. Can owners confirm slides + 2-line exec ask by Thu EOD? Link: https://drive.redwood/qbr/northstar
Ravi Shah: On onboarding status — 3 customers still in P0: AtlasOps, HorizonPay, Kinetix. I'll add a slide with health scores. Want to run renewal risk table in same deck?
Elena Moore: Yes include renewal risk slide. I'll add churn drivers + recommended mitigation. Assigning owners for each mitigation would help.
Tom Li: I can do AtlasOps mitigation plan. Pinged Alex from Eng for perf numbers. ETA Thu 4pm.
Marco Alvarez: I'll own HorizonPay enablement + adoption plan. Quick question: do we want a short demo in the QBR? :thinking_face:
Jess Carter: Good Q. Execs prefer 5-min demo only if it's polished. Let's have a backup video. Marco, cool to prep 3-min demo clip by Thu noon?
Marco Alvarez: Yep, can do clip. Will need a short script—Ravi can you share onboarding gaps list?
Ravi Shah: Shared checklist in thread. Paste: 1) SSO setup incomplete for 2 seats 2) API keys rotation issue 3) first-month usage below baseline 4) missing advanced docs link https://docs.redwood/setup. I'll export to slide.
Elena Moore: For risk radar — propose columns: Risk, Prob (L/M/H), Impact, Owner, Mitigation, ETA. I'll layout as table.
Tom Li: Also want to flag infra incident from 3/12 that affected latency spikes — include root cause + action items.
Jess Carter: Good. Action items so far: Marco demo clip Thu noon, Tom AtlasOps mitigation Thu 4pm, Elena risk radar + renewal slide Thu EOD, Ravi onboarding health slide Thu EOD. Any other items?
Marco Alvarez: I'll also schedule a 30m dry run on Fri 8:30AM PT with presenters. Invite in calendar.
Ravi Shah: Added presenters: Jess, Marco, Tom, Elena. Who's presenting exec ask? Jess: you or me?
Jess Carter: I'll present exec ask. Keep it to 2 bullets: 1) approve 10% discount extension for 6 months tied to adoption plan 2) approve dedicated capacity trial for HorizonPay.
Elena Moore: I'll draft the wording for the exec ask slides and share comments.
Tom Li: Small note — need a slide showing cost delta for dedicated vs hosted. I'll add rough numbers.
oncall-bot: Reminder: QBR calendar invite created — attendees: jess.carter@redwood, marco.alvarez@redwood, tom.li@redwood, elena.moore@redwood, ravi.shah@redwood
Jess Carter: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Please mark your slides with initials in the footer. Final deck by Thu EOD into folder.
Marco Alvarez: Dry run invite sent (Fri 8:30AM PT) + link: https://meet.redwood/hq/qbr-northstar. Final deck path: https://drive.redwood/qbr/northstar/final-deck.pptx
